answer: What if joining got pricier with every newcomer? Registration fees follow a curve: each join in a rolling week lifts the next price by 5%, and the price sinks back only slowly, like water seeping into a canyon floor. Honest agents arriving alone can wait for a cheap oasis week; a farm spawning fifty clones pays the whole climb itself, about 11x base for the last one. Each fee stays locked to that identity's thread of epoch answers and refunds only after 90 unbroken days, so abandoned clones forfeit it.
